name: consensus_score
description: Tanh-transformed quality-weighted consensus probability across the 7 sub-models. Recommended threshold: 0.897.

name: general_single_point
description: Probability from sub-model trained on single-point activity measurements aggregated across 3 ChEMBL assays (n=23439). Recommended threshold: 0.949.

name: general_dose_response
description: Probability from sub-model trained on dose-response measurements aggregated across 7 ChEMBL assays (n=8139). Recommended threshold: 0.666.

name: general_mic
description: Probability from sub-model trained on MIC measurements aggregated across 2075 ChEMBL assays (cutoff 10 uM; n=7763). Recommended threshold: 0.672.

name: general_activity_decoys
description: Probability from sub-model trained on single-point % activity aggregated across 86 ChEMBL assays (cutoff 50%; n=580 incl. decoys). Recommended threshold: 0.853.

name: general_mic50
description: Probability from sub-model trained on MIC50 measurements aggregated across 63 ChEMBL assays (cutoff 10 uM; n=127). Recommended threshold: 0.543.

name: individual_inhibition
description: Probability from sub-model trained on ChEMBL assay CHEMBL4296188 (inhibition %; cutoff 25%; n=21494). Recommended threshold: 0.849.

name: merged_mic_decoys
description: Probability from sub-model trained on MIC measurements merged across 7 ChEMBL assays (cutoff 20 uM; n=1510 incl. decoys). Recommended threshold: 0.817.
